subject.title: Feishu announce delivery never succeeds for isolated cron jobs; fallbackUsed inconsistently rescues output

question: Should #102412 be fixed as a distinct explicit Feishu cron-delivery bug, or folded into the broader isolated-cron route/lifecycle/status repair cluster?
rationale: The source path shows Feishu targets can be explicit and direct delivery exists, but the field evidence could come from cron source-delivery, yielded/deferred lifecycle, or delivery-status semantics, and each repair path changes different compatibility-sensitive surfaces.

options.title: Trace And Scope Feishu Explicit Delivery
options.body: Request one redacted current-main Feishu cron trace, then repair the narrow cron-to-Feishu dispatch path if the target reaches resolution but not `sendMessageFeishu`.

options.title: Fold Into Cron Route/Lifecycle Design
options.body: Treat this as another symptom of #92460/#94846/#49190 and close it only after the accepted shared cron delivery design proves this Feishu shape.

options.title: Wait For More Field Logs
options.body: Keep the issue open but defer implementation until logs distinguish primary message-tool delivery, direct fallback delivery, and no-dispatch paths.

recommendation.title: Trace And Scope Feishu Explicit Delivery
recommendation.body: Request one redacted current-main Feishu cron trace, then repair the narrow cron-to-Feishu dispatch path if the target reaches resolution but not `sendMessageFeishu`.
